findings.claim: 10-K 揭露：公司向美國政府機關通報內部調查（Army CIO 聘用案）並配合司法部（DOJ）自行展開的調查；公司無法預測時程、結果或影響。
findings.excerpt: The Company has informed the Department of Justice, the Department of Defense Office of Inspector General and the Army Suspension and Debarment Office of the investigation and is continuing to cooperate with the Department of Justice, which has commenced its own investigation and required the Company to deliver certain documents in connection with these matters. The Company cannot predict the timing, outcome or possible impact of the investigation.

findings.claim: 10-K Item 3 稱訴訟與法律程序個別或合計不預期造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: we do not believe that the ultimate resolution of any such proceedings, whether taken individually or in the aggregate, is likely to have a material adverse effect on our business, financial position, results of operations or cash flows.

findings.claim: DOJ 曾對 Moveworks 收購案做深度反壟斷審查（second request）；該收購於 2025-12-15 完成。未找到 2026 年 DOJ/FTC/歐盟針對 NOW 的反壟斷調查或拆分風險。

note: 2026 年查無 FTC/EU 反壟斷行動；Moveworks 審查最終結論未見明文報導。
